<!DOCTYPE note [
  <!ELEMENT note (to,from,heading,body)>
  <!ELEMENT to (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT from (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT heading (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT body (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY writer "Tove">
]>
<note>
  <to>Tove</to>
  <from>&writer;</from>
  <heading>Reminder</heading>
  <body>Don't forget me this weekend!</body>
</note>
